static_traits.name: Lin Sha
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友可交谈，但难以就Loneliness与疏离感敞开，友谊Relationship tension、感觉与朋友疏离
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 语气中性偏平稳，表达清晰、配合度较好；能主动描述被忽视与Loneliness感，动机感下降

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得朋友们认为我的生活方式很without聊，这导致我感到Loneliness和被孤立。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想感到被接纳和被重视，能与朋友自然相处而not觉得是在强迫他们与我一起。

core_beliefs: 我not有趣（我的生活方式很without聊）

special_situations.event: 看到朋友在have not邀请自己的情况下一起聚会或外出
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not参与他们喜欢的活动，他们就会觉得我without聊，not会愿意和我在一起
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: More frequently initiates contact with friends, proposes low-intensity activities closer to one's own lifestyle to seek acceptance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我without聊、not想和我在一起

special_situations.event: 朋友have not及时回复自己的消息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not及时回应，说明我对他们not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing message frequency, proactively suggesting activities to confirm the relationship

special_situations.event: 注意到朋友更频繁地组织以派对/外出为主的活动而自己not参与
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not参与他们偏好的活动，就证明我是without趣的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试提出not同类型、较为低调的活动希望对方接受
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们总是把我排除在外，因为我太without聊

special_situations.event: 尝试更多联系与提出not同活动后仍not yet见改善
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我尝试了也not变化，那关系就not会好转
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces participation and motivation, reduces investment in activities she originally liked
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 看来以后也not会有什么改变

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be accepted, valued by friends, and get along naturally
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与排斥、害怕自己not重要/not被需要
defense_goal: 通过谨慎地自我表达、寻求迎合或降低期待来减轻Being rejected的风险

object_relations.self_representation: 被忽视、not被需要的旁观者
object_relations.object_representation: 疏离、对自己not感兴趣的朋友群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying new small steps or strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为“我已经试过所有方法也without效”，对进一步尝试持消极Anticipation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平和但带without力感，重复“我都试过了”“好像have not用”等表述，弱化对新方案的开放度。

manifestations: 朋友经常在have not邀请自己的情况下聚会
难以向朋友敞开谈论Loneliness与被孤立的感受
Loses motivation for activities originally enjoyed (fitness, reading, cooking)
出现“如果总是Loneliness，这些活动有什么意义”的念头

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将朋友的疏远直接解释为“他们觉得我without聊”“not想和我在一起”
Speculating others' negative views of oneself without evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 过度自我归因为“not参与他们的活动导致疏远”
难以就真实感受（Loneliness、被忽视）向朋友敞开

positive_force: Willing to try small steps and behavioral experiments to test cognitions
Can proactively contact friends and propose activity suggestions
Has some social resources (still has friends to talk to)
negative_force: Thinking pattern biased toward mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization
难以向朋友表达Loneliness与需求，倾向沉默与Self-denial
Decreased motivation，减少参与原本喜欢的活动，进一步弱化联结

target_behavior.behavior: 在人际拒绝线索下出现强烈被忽视感并降低社交与日常活动参与（Loneliness感与without动力）
antecedent: 看到朋友聚会not yet邀请自己
朋友not yet及时回复消息
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人行为解读为对自己的negate（读心、过度概括、个人化），并以“我很without聊/not重要”的核心信念维持
target_behavior.function: 避免进一步Being rejected以保护自尊（情绪逃避），同时试图通过迎合或更频繁联系获得确认
target_behavior.consequence: 社交连接进一步减少、Loneliness加重；对健身、阅读、烹饪等活动的动力显著下降
